title: "Python Analysis: GDP per Capita: Taiwan vs. Canada"

---

Data: Gapminder (https://www.gapminder.org/data/), 
via the Software Carpentry r-novice-gapminder lesson 
(https://github.com/swcarpentry/r-novice-gapminder), CC BY 4.0.

```{python}
#| label: setup
#| message: false
#| warning: false
import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

df = pd.read_csv("gapminder.csv")
```

```{python}
#| label: prep-data
gdp_compare = df[df["country"].isin(["Taiwan", "Canada"])].copy()
gdp_compare["gdp_total_billions"] = (gdp_compare["gdpPercap"] * gdp_compare["pop"]) / 1e9
gdp_compare.head()
```

```{python}
#| label: growth-rates
def compute(group):
    start = group.loc[group["year"].idxmin()]
    end = group.loc[group["year"].idxmax()]
    years = end["year"] - start["year"]
    rate = (end["gdpPercap"] / start["gdpPercap"]) ** (1 / years) - 1
    return pd.Series(
        {
            "start_year": start["year"],
            "end_year": end["year"],
            "gdpPercap_start": start["gdpPercap"],
            "gdpPercap_end": end["gdpPercap"],
            "cagr_pct": rate * 100,
        }
    )


growth_table = gdp_compare.groupby("country").apply(compute).reset_index()
growth_table.round(2)
```

```{python}
#| label: fig-gdp-comparison
#| fig-cap: "GDP per Capita Comparison: Taiwan vs. Canada"
#| fig-alt: "Line plot showing GDP per capita trends for Taiwan and Canada from Gapminder data."

plt.figure(figsize=(8, 5))

for country, group in gdp_compare.groupby("country"):
    plt.plot(group["year"], group["gdpPercap"], marker = "o", label = country)

plt.title("GDP per Capita: Taiwan vs. Canada")
plt.xlabel("Year")
plt.ylabel("GDP per Capita (USD)")
plt.legend()
plt.grid(True, linestyle = "--", alpha=0.6)
plt.tight_layout()

plt.show()
```
